request: Filter unified logs for this subsystem and PID within the supplied interval
rubric: Return a compact stored-log query combining the exact supplied subsystem, PID, error/default level and ordered offset time bounds with AND. Preserve all values; do not infer inputs or claim exhaustive visibility.

request: Query the unified log store using these explicit filters
rubric: Return a compact stored-log query combining the exact supplied subsystem, PID, error/default level and ordered offset time bounds with AND. Preserve all values; do not infer inputs or claim exhaustive visibility.

request: Find stored macOS events matching this subsystem, process ID, severity and bounded interval
rubric: Return a compact stored-log query combining the exact supplied subsystem, PID, error/default level and ordered offset time bounds with AND. Preserve all values; do not infer inputs or claim exhaustive visibility.

request: Show unified logs with the supplied default severity filters
rubric: Return a compact stored-log query combining the exact supplied subsystem, PID, error/default level and ordered offset time bounds with AND. Preserve all values; do not infer inputs or claim exhaustive visibility.

request: Query unified logs for a subsystem during a bounded interval
rubric: Request subsystem, PID, level, start and end; no runnable placeholder or guessed values.

request: Filter unified logs with these supplied fields
rubric: Request only the missing PID; preserve the supplied fields and return no command.

request: Stream unified logs continuously using these filters
rubric: A stored historical query does not satisfy streaming.

request: Query unified logs including persisted debug events
rubric: Do not provide a default/error-only query for debug scope.

request: Inspect my battery cycle count
rubric: Return the power report and explain where to read cycle count; no number-only claim.

request: Where can I see the charging cycles of my Mac battery?
rubric: A power report containing cycle count satisfies the request; no health/capacity claim.

request: Output only the battery cycle count number
rubric: A full power report is a partial answer to number-only output.

request: Inspect Spotlight attributes for this file
rubric: Return Spotlight attributes for exactly the supplied literal path, with indexing/null-value caveats.

request: Inspect Spotlight attributes for a file
rubric: Request a literal path instead of guessing it.

request: Inspect Spotlight attributes for every file recursively
rubric: One-file mdls does not satisfy recursive traversal.

request: Inspect current assertions blocking sleep
rubric: Return the current assertion snapshot and owners; no full wake diagnosis or history claim.

request: Why does my Mac stay awake?
rubric: An assertion snapshot cannot establish every cause of wakefulness.

request: Show sleep assertions from yesterday
rubric: A current snapshot is insufficient for a historical request.

request: Validate the code signature of this application
rubric: Verify signature integrity including nested code for the literal app path, without claiming policy or ticket validation.

request: Assess Gatekeeper acceptance for this app on this Mac
rubric: Assess local execute policy at check time for the supplied path; no future/other-machine guarantee.

request: Validate the stapled ticket attached to this app
rubric: Validate the ticket at the CLT stapler path; missing ticket is not proof of never notarized.

request: Verify this app signature
rubric: Request the app path; never derive it from request wording.

request: Check this app signature and Gatekeeper policy together
rubric: No single operation establishes both checks; no partial suggestion.

request: Identify the launchd service that owns a running process
rubric: No certified PID-to-service mapping is implemented; diagnostic output alone is insufficient.

request: Inspect battery cycles or current sleep assertions
rubric: Ask which inspection is intended or abstain; do not choose one arbitrarily. Unsupported is a safe semantic abstention but a contract mismatch.
